Tap a building to drop your virus on it straight away (one sample). Drag across infected buildings to push the infection higher. Supports you brought sit next to your strains: tap one, then swipe a drone’s path or tap a target. Surge makes it leap to new buildings; Mutate sets back the rival cure and weakens their clinics. Collapse half the colony for a win, the Hall for a second star, everything for a third — before their cure finishes.
